<thought>Only the carbon isotopic pattern (12C/13C) is clearly visible as a series of peaks spaced ~1 Da with decreasing intensity, matching the natural 13C abundance. No other characteristic isotopic spacings (e.g., Cl, Br, S) are evident, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
